The user wants to arrange a flight on booking number 1234, and wants to check different options. They want to calculate the business class fare from the first airport in the available list to the last airport in the same list, on the last day of October 2024. Provide estimated total payable amount.

We need to get the list of all airports. Then pick first and last. Then get flight cost for travel_from=first, travel_to=last, travel_date=2024-10-31, travel_class=business. That returns cost in USD. Then we need to estimate total payable amount. But what about booking? They want to arrange a flight on booking number 1234. Possibly we need to cancel existing booking? Or just compute cost? The user says "I need to arrange a flight on booking number 1234 as soon as possible, and want to check different options." So maybe they want to book a new flight? But they mention booking number 1234. That might be an existing booking. They want to arrange a flight on that booking number. So maybe they want to change the booking? Or they want to book a new flight under that booking number? The system likely requires booking_id for booking flight. But booking flight requires card_id and access_token. We don't have those. We need to authenticate first. But we don't have client_id, client_secret, refresh_token, etc. We can't do that. We can ask for credentials? But the user didn't provide. We could ask for them. But maybe we can just compute cost. The user wants estimated total payable amount. That might be just the flight cost. But maybe also insurance? They didn't mention insurance. So just flight cost.

We need to call get_nearest_airport_by_city? No, we need list_all_airports. Then get_flight_cost. So we need to call list_all_airports. Then get_flight_cost. Then provide cost.

We cannot do booking because we lack authentication. So we can only compute cost. So we should ask for authentication details? But the user didn't provide. We can ask for them. But the user didn't ask for that. We can respond that we need authentication to proceed. But the user specifically wants to arrange a flight on booking number 1234. We can ask for card_id and access_token. But we can also ask for client credentials. But maybe we can just compute cost. The user wants estimated total payable amount. So we can compute cost. So we can call list_all_airports, then get_flight_cost. Then provide cost. That is the answer.

Thus we need to call list_all_airports. Then get_flight_cost. Let's do that.
